messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up 2: we're creating a small hiring pod to own Runtime Ops hires (SRE, Runtime Eng, Infra PM). Ethan Rodriguez will be Interim Lead for the pod starting Mon. This is to speed up ramp for Dedicated/Private hires.
Ethan Rodriguez: thanks @Maya 44f Ill run the pod and coordinate with Eng managers to triage reqs. first deliverable: top-5 priority reqs + interview loops by Friday.
Nora Li: congrats Ethan! quick Q: will leveling change for internal backfills or keep existing bands?
Maya Singh: keep bands same for now. exceptions routed to People Ops for case-by-case review.
Jared Kim: pls prioritize Senior SRE (runtime) and Inference Runtime Engineer. those two are blocking our next infra rollout.
Ethan Rodriguez: agreed. priority list will be: 1) Senior SRE (runtime), 2) Inference Runtime Eng, 3) Backend Eng (KV cache), 4) Infra PM (serving), 5) Tech Recruiter (runtime focus).
Nora Li: interview loop ask: do we want a hands-on runtime exercise? i can draft a short sandbox task if helpful.
Ethan Rodriguez: yes please 4dd a small runtime debugging + perf tuning lab (30-45m) is ideal. keep it focused on cache eviction and tail latency.
PeopleOps-Bot: Task created: "Create Runtime hiring pod tracker" due in 2 days. Link: https://redwood.example.com/recruiting/tasks/7392
Jared Kim: any changes to oncall expectations we should include in JD?
Maya Singh: add "oncall experience with distributed systems" and "familiarity with GPU infra" as preferred.
Ethan Rodriguez: i'll put a GH board column and update hiring ops with loops + draft exercise by Thu. will schedule a 15m weekly sync for hiring blockers starting next Tue 9am PT.
Nora Li: I'll share the sandbox draft and interview rubric once ready.
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder: update req owners in Greenhouse to point to Ethan (interim) to ensure outreach goes to pod.
Ethan Rodriguez: thanks everyone 389 ping me in DMs for urgent candidate referrals.
_metadata_note: No title field included per agents.md. Thread stored as a single continuous string with messages in chronological order.
